brain.haiku.note: THE ACTUAL PRODUCT FIX this ticket exists to make. ai_dispatch_ipc.ts's CHEAP_CLOUD_BRAIN (TIER 3 cheap-cloud rung) and agent_probe.ts's health-check ping were dispatching 'claude-haiku-4-7' -- a string that does NOT appear anywhere on the vendor's own live pricing page (independently re-confirmed by THIS dispatch's own fresh WebFetch of https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing at 2026-09-08T02:40Z, corroborating the prior dispatch D-BP223-M0-h2cbpo68-032's two independent fetches at 02:14Z/02:15Z that same day: Haiku family present on the page is 'Claude Haiku 4.5' at $1/$5 per MTok and 'Claude Haiku 3.5 (retired...)' at $0.80/$4 -- NO 'Claude Haiku 4.7' row and NO 'Claude Haiku 4.8' row exist on the page at all). The Founder's own verbal recollection this dispatch was given ('Haiku4.7 was replaced with 4.8') does NOT match the live page -- per this dispatch's explicit instruction to trust the page over the sentence, brain.haiku is set to claude-haiku-4-5, the page's actual current (non-retired) Haiku SKU, not claude-haiku-4-8. claude-haiku-4-5 is ALREADY a priced row in config/substrate_price_table.json ($1/$5, effective_from 2026-01-01), so this single roster correction also resolves the prior dispatch's 'unpriced_models' entry for claude-haiku-4-7 going forward: new TIER-3 cheap-cloud dispatches will price correctly instead of resolving UNMEASURED. The claude-haiku-4-7 unpriced_models entry and its price-table absence are DELIBERATELY NOT deleted (Rule 66 / HIVI discipline -- the historical record that the product WAS dispatching an unpriced ghost SKU stays on file); substrate_savings_receipt.test.ts's existing test (c) for claude-haiku-4-7 is therefore still correct and left unchanged. This is a Founder-visible finding, not a unilateral model-tier upgrade: the Founder's own recollection of '4.8' could not be verified and should be raised back to him -- see the dispatch's own Return doc.
